checkpoints.name: seed-status
args: (async()=>{const orb=window.__orb;if(!orb)throw new Error('__orb unavailable');const seeded=await orb.seed.game({profile:'d20'});if(!seeded||typeof seeded.chatId!=='string'||seeded.chatId.length===0)throw new Error('seed.game returned no chatId');const opened=await orb.nav.openChat(seeded.chatId);if(!opened.ok)throw new Error('openChat refused: '+opened.reason);return {chatId:seeded.chatId,openChat:opened};})()

checkpoints.name: phase-locked-map
args: (async()=>{const orb=window.__orb;if(!orb)throw new Error('__orb unavailable');const caps=orb.nav.capabilities();if(!caps.contextTabs.includes('rpg.map'))throw new Error('phase-locked rpg.map was not published for this game');const opened=await orb.nav.contextTab('rpg.map');if(!opened.ok)throw new Error('rpg.map refused: '+opened.reason);return {tab:'rpg.map',status:'opened',lock:'Maps unlock with the map arc'};})()

checkpoints.name: host-game
args: (async()=>{const orb=window.__orb;if(!orb)throw new Error('__orb unavailable');const caps=orb.nav.capabilities();if(!caps.contextTabs.includes('rpg.game'))return {tab:'rpg.game',status:'skipped',reason:'host-only tab not published for this viewer'};const opened=await orb.nav.contextTab('rpg.game');if(!opened.ok)throw new Error('rpg.game refused after publication: '+opened.reason);return {tab:'rpg.game',status:'opened'};})()
